setting.pickupnotifications.modEnabled.t: Whether notifications are shown at all.
setting.pickupnotifications.trackExperie: Whether to track picked up experience orbs.
setting.pickupnotifications.maxNotificat: How many notifications can be on the screen at a time. Additional notifications will be queued up and shown once there is room.
setting.pickupnotifications.iconAlignmen: Whether the item icons should appear on the 'left' or 'right' of notifications, always on the 'outside' (left for left-aligned, right for right-aligned), or always on the 'inside' of notifications.
setting.pickupnotifications.showUniqueIn: Whether to show custom names, rarity, and enchantments in the notifications.
setting.pickupnotifications.renderBackgr: Whether to render the background behind notifications.
setting.pickupnotifications.backgroundOp: Opacity of the notification background color.
setting.pickupnotifications.renderShadow: Whether to render text shadow in notifications.
